The endless card game "C21A" is an exciting combination of classic blackjack and addictive strategy. In this game, your goal is to collect cards to score 21 points. But be careful not to overdo it or you will lose! The game offers endless opportunities to develop and improve your skills.
The game "C21A" is a great way to pass your time and test your skills in card games.

title: Impostor among us: Escape from prison
description:
The traitor ended up in a space prison. But the impostor does not plan to stay there for long. You play as an impostor who must go through all the traps, solve puzzles and kill all the enemies on the level. Once the imposter has neutralized all the amogus, he will be able to break out of prison. But the evil among will not let you go into space so easily.

- 100+ varied and colorful levels.
- To kill the enemy you need to approach him.
- Logic tasks and puzzles!
- Boss battles!

title: Hazel Tangle Rope 3D: Sorting Puzzle
description: Untangle colorful twisted ropes in this satisfying 3D brain-teaser puzzle game. Strategically select and move rope endpoints to separate tangled knots and sort them by color. Use logical thinking and spatial reasoning to solve increasingly complex rope puzzles and become a tangle master.

description:
Welcome to Merge Racer - Stunts Car! This is an exciting and creative racing game. You show your driving skills and use the power of merge to build supercars! Merge the same types of cars to create stronger racing machines. Each merge improves your car’s performance, helping
you speed ahead of your rivals.

title: MiniBattles
description: MiniBattles (2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 player games) is an interesting local multiplayer one-button battle game that supports up to 6 players simultaneously in various mini games, such as soccer, cars, tanks, archers, and many more! Release Date June 2020 (Android).

Race, roll, and clash in Marble Run, the ultimate marble racing game! Guide your marble through physics-based tracks, dodge obstacles, knock rivals off the edge, and aim for the finish line. 

With fast-paced races, competitive knockout rounds, and fun marble skins, it’s the most addictive 3D marble runner you’ll play!

Welcome to "Lumber Mill Simulator"! This is an exciting game where you own a sawmill.
Your success depends on your ability to make informed decisions, effectively manage resources and grow your business. Are you ready to become a great lumber tycoon?

description:
Get ready for some beaver fun in LOGic Slide – the cutest puzzle in the forest!
Meet two friendly beavers who love playing with wood. They need your help to slide the logs and make one big river-wide log . 
It might look easy, but you’ll need to think and figure out where each log should go!

Let’s slide some logs together with the beavers – start playing right away! ?✨

description: Happy Farm: A Fun Farming ExperienceBuild your own farm, do gardening, grow crops, and raise animals such as chickens, pigs, cows, sheep, and more. Construct factories to produce a wide variety of goods and sell them through order invoices.

description:
Put together cozy blanket pieces with the same colors and patterns to make them disappear and keep your board nice and neat!
With soft colors and a calm, happy feel, Blankets is great for kids who like fun puzzles without too much stress.

Can you build the coziest blanket and get the best score in Blankets?

description: Halloween Merge Mania is a fast-paced casual game with a fun Halloween vibe. Cute monster balls—pumpkins, black cats, mummies, vampires, and other iconic characters—appear on the screen. Your task is to merge identical creatures to create new, rarer, and more valuable ones. Each successful merge unlocks the next level of spooky yet adorable monsters, while the dark background and vivid graphics immerse you in the festive autumn atmosphere.

title: Moto Trials Rush
description:
Welcome to the thrilling world of Motorcycle Racing, where driving skills are essential! Dodge obstacles, avoid flying sledgehammers, and leap over spikes—your path to victory depends on it!
Each new level presents a unique challenge, where quick reflexes and sharp focus are your best defense!

Test your timing, precision, and reflexes in this endless jumping adventure built with smooth physics and clean visuals.

description: Uncover safe squares, avoid mines, and test your strategic insight in this massively addicting puzzle game!

description: Car Care Repair DuDu Mechanic is a casual simulation game where you act as a skillful mechanic. Your clients meet diverse problems with their cars: broken windows, cracked car doors, flat tires, malfunctioning motors, lack of car parts...

description:
In this game, you roll dice and accumulate coins. Upgrade dice to generate more coins, even when you are not actively playing (Offline earnings).

Idle Dice 3D stands out with its variety of dice: from classic six-sided to dice with 2, 4, 8, 10, 12, and 20 sides. Aim for combinations like pairs, triples, straights, and more to increase profit.

The Prestige system allows you to reset your progress to boost future earnings, adding a strategic element to the game. The game also has achievements.

description: Welcome to Color Sand Puzzle! Relax and unwind with Color Sand Puzzle, a refreshing take on the classic block puzzle game! Your mission is simple yet fun—fill the grid with matching colors of sand to clear and control the lines. As colorful sand blocks fall from the top, you’ll need to strategically arrange them to form complete horizontal rows. When the sand lines up from left to right, they disappear, and you earn points!

Design stunning acrylic nails with trendy styles, vibrant colors, and charming accessories. Satisfy your customers' unique requests, earn money, and upgrade your salon to become the best nail stylist in town!

Immerse yourself in a fascinating plot and follow a brave video blogger who bravely goes into the dark embrace of an abandoned mansion. As you make your way through each carefully designed room, you'll encounter a series of cryptic puzzles and mind-bending challenges that will test your intelligence, observation, and creative thinking.
As the plot develops, you will be plunged into the darkness of the house's past and the mysterious history of its former inhabitants.

title: Cute Sheep SkyBlock
description: Two cute sheep must jump from island to island in the sky to escape from the farmers and reach the portal. They need to work together as a team to overcome obstacles. You must help them. Be careful of the obstacles that fall from the ground and sky. The farmers are looking for you, and they want to catch you, so jump over them to escape. If the path is clear, eat all the hay you find. Gather all the hay and safely reach the portal.

title: Merge Hospital
description:
Play as Doctor Player in Merge Hospital and discover the many secrets of your staff members, and what is happening in and around the Hospital. In Merge Hospital by Operate Now you will merge and build, meet and love many skilled surgeons, doctors and other interesting characters. You will learn more about their stories and how they got into the hospital.

As Dr. Player you must:
MERGE medical items, pies and much more!
DISCOVER the story of a medical drama like in your favorite TV shows.

title: Screw Masters 3D Puzzle
description:
Collect screws, take apart complex objects piece by piece, and test your puzzle-solving skills! Work your way through exciting levels, dismantle items down to the tiniest parts, and earn amazing rewards along the way. Use powerful bonuses to advance faster, beat challenging stages, and reach new heights.
Play, win, and share your best results with friends!

description: Money Printer is an unconventional and captivating adventure puzzle escape game that cleverly mixes the mundane routine of a 9-to-5 office job with the excitement of a daring escape mission. As the protagonist, you’re stuck in a monotonous office environment, clocking in from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, where your primary task during this twelve-hour day is relatively simple—to print money.

description: Catch a Fish Obby is a chaotic collector raider set in a bright obby world full of Fish and Brainrot Fish characters. Build a money making base with your favorite sea creatures, sneak into rival bases to steal their fish, and protect your own tank from greedy bots and other players.

description: Hill Travel 3D is a rugged driving adventure where you choose your vehicle and climb your way up an increasingly treacherous mountain. Tackle 15 diverse levels with unique terrain—from slick snow to deep mud—that directly impacts your car's handling.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Idle Airport CEO
description:
Step into the shoes of a savvy CEO and take control of your very own airport!

As you progress, collect passengers and upgrade your capabilities to increase plane capacity, speed, and efficiency. Optimize check-in times, revenue streams, and airline services to keep your customers happy and coming back for more.

Oh, and did we mention that your money is piling up as we speak? Go offline, return and claim profits.

genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Get Ready With Me: Concert Day
description: Join us in the excitement as you follow the thrilling journey of teen Riri, who is preparing for the concert of a lifetime. From choosing the perfect outfit to applying stunning makeup, you'll get to walk her through all the steps of this beautifying process. But before you start the fun, be sure to help her customize her cowgirl hat, a signature item for the concert she will attend. Then go crazy with the makeup, dress her up in a jaw-dropping outfit, and accessorize for a complete look.

title: Soccer Euro Cup 2025
description:
Can you hear the deafening cheers of a mighty crowd? Get pumped for the Soccer Euro Cup 2025!

Pick your favorite country to represent and get ready for kickoff. Do your best to kick or headbutt the ball into your opponent's goal!

How many did you manage to score? Play now, and let's find out!

title: Going Balls Adventure 2
description: Going Balls Adventure 2 is a ball-rolling arcade game with a 3D game engine. Your main mission is to collect black balls and reach the checkpoint. Your side mission is to collect all coins on the platform. It doesn't matter if you don't fish the job. Before the level begins, you have a chance to try some free skins for you to decide on a favorite one.

title: Idle Airline Tycoon
description: Manage your airline and expand to every corner of the world! Features      50+ cities across continents to connect with your airline     Select from 25 different airplanes for your route     Upgrade your airports to attract more travelers     Earn money while you are offline as well     Advance your career with optional prestige system  Release Date May 2020 Developer Idle Airline Tycoon is made by Fish Pond Studio.

title: HomeRun Derby
description: Step up to the plate and experience the excitement of Baseball's exhilarating Home Run Derby! Swing your bat and aim for the fences to hit as many home runs as you can. Time your swings carefully to score big points and keep the crowd cheering! How many home runs can you hit in a row? Test your skills and see if you can become the ultimate Home Run champion!

description: You have a powerful cannon loaded with Stickman Ragdols which you must shoot far to reach your target! Solve all kinds of challenges as you collect gems, avoid obstacles and control your throws to reach the targets in each level. Try not to bump into obstacles along the way and use all the raggedy characters you need to have fun with these amazing challenges - good luck!

title: 1010 Elixir Alchemy
description: Enter the enchanting world of '1010 Elixir Alchemy', where strategic placement reigns supreme. Strategically place Tetris-style blocks on a 10x10 grid to collect Elixirs. Complete rows or columns to gather Elixirs. If the grid fills up with remaining Elixirs, it's game over. With 60 levels, master the art of alchemy in this addictive adventure!

title: GMOD Bombs
description:
Experience the power of a high-tech laser cannon in the GMOD Bombs! Collect bombs, create cities, and aim to destroy objects on the map and enjoy spectacular explosions.
GMOD Bombs is an exciting game where you take on the role of a bombardier armed with a futuristic laser cannon. Your task is to collect bombs and strategically destroy various objects and structures on the map. Each bomb has a unique flight trajectory and blast radius, which requires precision and aiming skills.

title: Connect Clues - The Missing Professor
description:
A tangled detective story is about to unfold.

Inspector Hale and Detective Crane are on the trail of a mysteriously vanished professor of history and archaeology — who also happens to be Crane’s old friend.
Professor Eldridge was always a touch eccentric, but disappearing without a word and leaving his office turned upside down was never part of his habits. He’s clearly in trouble — and in need of help.

title: Free Rally: Lost Angeles
description: Free Rally: Lost Angeles is the extension of the Free Rally multiplayer series. This time you play in a huge industrial city similar to LA.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

description: Blast your way through the galaxy in intense battles. Enjoy beautiful graphic and exciting gameplay with tons of enemies as customizable ships.

title: Musketeers Gunpowder vs Steel
description: Take command in Musketeers: Gunpowder vs Steel, a strategic 17th-century battle experience. Lead musketeers, pikemen, and reiters as a mercenary commander, issuing orders, engaging in combat, and training troops. Master tactics, crush your enemies, and claim victory on the battlefield.

title: Elementz
description: ElementZ is a Match-3 game similar to Bejeweled or Candy Crush. Its particularity lies in giving each color its elemental power, allowing you to trigger different powers of fire (red), water (blue), earth (brown), plants (green), and electricity (yellow).

title: Pixel Destroyer
description:
Pixel Destroyer is an exciting physics-based arcade puzzle game where your goal is to destroy colorful pixel shapes using bouncing balls.

Dive into a world of pixel destruction! In this game, you’ll need to use your wits and precision. Each level features a unique shape made of pixel blocks. Your objective is to destroy them all using a limited number of shots. The balls follow the laws of physics, bouncing off walls and obstacles, allowing you to reach even the most hard-to-access blocks.

title: Merge cubes 2048 3D
description: A completely new approach to the classic game 2048?! Now in 3D and with dynamic physics?! Number cubes don't just merge - they bounce and collide?, adding an element of surprise to every game! Compete with friends or colleagues?!

title: Penguin Farm - Ice Merge
description:
Explore a world of frozen islands where penguins run their own farm. Collect resources, merge wood, build and upgrade buildings to open up new territories. Develop your settlement step by step, expand your glaciers, and watch your income grow.
Train your penguins, improve production, and head to the ocean for rewards—there drift chests filled with valuable treasures. Upgrade each building, manage your resources, and turn your small island into a thriving icy farm.

title: Darts Jam
description:
This is a casual game of shooting balloons with darts.

When all the darts are pulled out, the board will also fall. When all the boards fall, the game is won.

The game is easy and simple to play, and the difficulty is getting stronger and stronger, which is challenging

genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

description: Welcome to 'Runic Block Collapse'! Tap any block to clear connected blocks in a chain reaction. Removing one block costs 250 points. Removing 2 or more blocks earns points, with larger groups earning more per block. Reach the target score to advance. If you fail, start over. Enjoy endless fun!

Two beautiful heroines are waiting for you in the game: an oriental beauty with exquisite outfits in the style of an Ottoman fairy tale and a stylish urban fashionista conquering the catwalks of the metropolis. description:
Dive into a delightful puzzle experience with Candy Puzzle Match, where matching candies is all about tapping! Simply tap on groups of two or more adjacent candies of the same color to clear them from the board. The more candies you clear at once, the higher your score!

Watch the board shift and cascade with every move as you complete deliciously fun objectives. With colorful visuals and satisfying chain reactions, this game is perfect for fans of casual and relaxing puzzle games.

title: Planet Evolution: Idle Clicker

Have fun!

With smooth mechanics and progressively difficult levels, Pool 8 offers a unique twist on classic pool gameplay, perfect for puzzle and strategy lovers.

With over 20 challenging levels, you'll need to think strategically to navigate obstacles like crabs and sandcastles. Enjoy a vibrant beach setting complete with golden sand, coconut trees, and a soothing soundtrack.

title: Color It in 3D
description:
Meet the best 3D coloring book!
Relax, immerse yourself in creativity and get inspired!
Draw and create fantasy, cartoon, funny and anime action figures!
If you like 3D character designs, drawing, coloring, then this coloring book is for you.

title: Upside Down
description:
Upside Down is a puzzle platformer game in which you must control the character, gather all of the stars and keys, and complete all of the levels.

The levels are difficult and mental exercises. In order to finish the levels, you have to switch between two distinct worlds. The lovely graphics and calming soundtrack make the game enjoyable and lovely. Go through the portal, leap, run, get away, and enjoy yourself.

title: Grandma's Last Stand
description:
Granny is in a hurry to get home and bake some pies. But there's one problem - first she needs to bake a few hundred zombies! They'll be chasing you in cars and motorcycles, they'll have machine guns, rocket launchers, and support drones. But you've got a pretty good arsenal too - from a revolver and machine guns to a minigun and a bazooka. Help Granny get home, roast them all!

title: Backpack Battles
description: Backpack Battles is an engaging battle game where strategic packing is key to your success! Assemble your items in your backpack, carefully considering their placement for maximum effectiveness in combat.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Noob Trolls Pro
description: Noob Trolls Pro is a funny game where you make prank videos. Become internet famous by trolling the unsuspecting Pro with a range of mischievous antics.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Max Speed
description: Race shiny sports cars on thrilling 3D tracks full of jumps, stunts, and intense battles. Explore exciting locations with unique challenges, perform daring tricks, upgrade and customize your cars, and test your skills in fast-paced arcade races. Enjoy high-speed action, stunning visuals, and nonstop adrenaline right in your browser.

title: Idle Legend
description: Dive into an exciting world! Fight monsters, gather battle energy, unlock bosses, and defeat them to earn coins. Spend coins on upgrades, skins, and pets. Enjoy vibrant cartoon graphics and exciting quests. Start your adventure today!

title: Gunblood
description: This town isn’t big enough for the two of us, so draw! If you have ever wanted to be a part of a western duel, then look no further than Gunblood!
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Happy Jump
description: Bounce into blissful heights with Happy Jump! Guide the cute chicken on its springy pogo to leap skyward amid lush trees and fun obstacles. Smash your personal best, snag stars, and chase trophies in this addictive, one-tap thrill. Endless jumps, soaring scores—pure joy awaits!

title: 100 Doors Challenge
description:
Do you like puzzles and hidden object games? Do you play games from the 100 Doors series? Then this point-and-click game is just what you need! Use all your skills to complete all levels and get all achievements.
The main goal in the "100 Doors Challenge" is to get out of the room. Using all the capabilities of the device, you need to open each of the 100 doors and move the elevator to the next floor. Find hidden objects, solve puzzles and use objects to do it!

title: Shoot Block Rush 3D
description: Shoot Block Rush 3D is a simple and easy-to-use shooting game consisting of many small levels. It doesn't require you to have great shooting skills. You need to choose the right abilities and paths to win. Your goal is to keep shooting in all directions and clear all the obstacles that stand in your way. Try to be the best destroyer and defeat the boss!

title: Ludo Star
description: Enter the arena of strategy and chance! Choose your favorite mode, unlock stylish dice skins and climb the trophy road. Outsmart opponents, master your moves and prove you’ve got what it takes to rule the board and become a Ludo Star.

title: SpelunKing
description: Dig into this deep match-3 expedition! Take a dive underground, search for your grandpa’s lost items, and collect precious stones to help the villagers around town rebuild Farnsbury. Upgrade buildings and unlock new facilities as you match deeper! Reach the bottom of the mine and become the Spelunk King (or Queen)!

title: Brat Girl Summer
description: Brat Girl Summer is the ultimate dress-up game where style meets attitude! Join four besties as you style them in trendy outfits inspired by K-pop and VSCO aesthetics.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Merge Balls Shooter 2048 Connect Fruits
description: Dive into Merge Balls Shooter 2048 Connect Fruits! Combine fruit balls in this unique blend of 2048 and billiards. Enjoy ASMR sounds, complete juicy levels, and compete with others. Master your merging skills and embark on a fun fruit-filled adventure today!

title: Archers Random
description: Archers Random is a fast-paced stickman archery game packed with action and strategy. Test your aim and reflexes in two exciting modes, Adventure Mode and 2 Player Mode.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game
